document.title: Turn comments into RSVPs

source.description_exact: “Comment to join” becomes “You're registered.” No forms, no fuss
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Turn comments into RSVPs
“Comment to join” becomes “You're registered.” No forms, no fuss
Business value
Meet people in the comments, easy. Turn hype into RSVPs with flows that don’t suck.
How does it work?
Post about your event. When someone comments “I’m in,” your bot slides into their DMs with the reg link, reminders, and maybe even a little teaser.
